segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I pulled up the quote in the CRM. Last time we had 42 seats, implementation starting September 3, and a target go-live of October 15. Is that still accurate?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Mostly, yeah. We need to bump that to 48 seats. Finance added six people who will need access for month-end close.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 48 seats. That moves the annual subscription to $57,600, and the implementation package stays at $8,500. I can update the pricing sheet after this.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And on billing, can the invoice be split? Our team wants subscription on one invoice and services on a separate one.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, we can do that in the billing tool. Subscription invoice for $57,600 on signature, and services invoice for $8,500 on the September 3 kickoff. Does that work?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Contract term is still twelve months, right? Legal asked if there was any auto-renewal language.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, twelve-month initial term. There is an auto-renewal for successive one-year terms, but cancellation is 30 days before renewal. If legal wants 60 days, I can send that through deal desk.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Thirty is fine. We just needed to know. For go-live, October 15 is okay, but we'd like the admin training the week of September 23.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, I’ll put admin training for September 24 and 26, two 90-minute sessions. We’ll also schedule end-user training the week before go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send the updated order form and the two-invoice note, and I’ll route it for signature today.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. You’ll have the revised order form by 2 p.m. Eastern, and I’ll include the implementation dates in the email so purchasing has everything in one place.
